name: query_ensembl
description: Query Ensembl REST API for gene annotation including genomic location, transcripts, and biotype
usage: from app.tools.biomni.database_connectors import query_ensembl; result = query_ensembl('BRCA2', species='human')
returns: dict with keys: gene_id, gene_name, chromosome, start, end, strand, biotype, transcripts (list), source
